crossRefs.note: Bathsheba bowed, and showed respect to the king. The king said, “What would you like?”
Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect…
Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

people.name: Nathan
people.line: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.

translations.web: They told the king, saying, “Behold, Nathan the prophet!” When he had come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
translations.bsb: So the king was told, “Nathan the prophet is here.” And Nathan went in and bowed facedown before the king.
translations.kjv: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
translations.asv: And they told the king, saying, Behold, Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
